metadata.description: Slash commands /pc, /pcq, /pcdesgin and /pcset: Claude plans + orchestrates, Codex executes.

plugins.name: pc-commands
plugins.description: /pc (plan -> Codex review -> execute -> verify), /pcq (quick: plan -> approve -> Codex -> verify), /pcdesgin (Codex UI -> Claude visual review -> fix until matching demo), /pcset (set Codex model + effort).

plugins.name: task-grid
plugins.description: /grid 2x3 - git-worktree task panes running claude in one Windows Terminal grid; /grid team - a role-based Claude team (PM, devs, reviewer, Unity integrator...) that coordinates through messages and a task board (Windows only).
